outfit.name: 极简冰丝细吊带与滑肩条纹衬衫
outfit.prose: A minimalist silk-touch ribbed ivory camisole with thread-thin spaghetti straps, worn under a breezy sky-blue striped cotton men's shirt slipping completely off one shoulder. Paired with relaxed linen drawstring lounge shorts and a single delicate silver chain looped around the upper thigh, barefoot.
